text_blocks.snippet: The name "COVID-19" was chosen for the disease caused by the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) for the following reasons:

list.title: Clarity and Simplicity:
list.snippet: The name provides a clear and concise identification of the disease.

list.title: Scientific Basis:
list.snippet: The name reflects the fact that the disease is caused by a virus ("corona") that was identified in 2019 ("19").

list.title: International Recognition:
list.snippet: The name is easily understood and recognized globally, facilitating communication and collaboration among healthcare professionals and researchers worldwide.

list.title: Avoidance of Stigma:
list.snippet: The name avoids using terms that could potentially stigmatize or discriminate against individuals or groups affected by the disease.

text_blocks.snippet: In summary, "COVID-19" is a scientifically accurate, internationally recognized, and user-friendly name that effectively identifies the disease and avoids unnecessary stigma.
